proposed_rules.trigger: A blank rectangular zone (no text, no bg tag) directly under the nav on video-template pages, sized/positioned like a player.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a single 'video' block (embed URL) rather than treating it as empty noise or an image block.
proposed_rules.rationale: Position and blank rendering is consistent with an iframe video embed whose content the DOM walker cannot read as text; rejected treating it as decorative noise since it's the primary content of a 'video' template.

proposed_rules.trigger: A single tagged node (e.g. [2x1]) with unusually large height and truncated text spanning multiple distinct logical sections (e.g. article body followed by a 'Related Posts' heading), with no visible children in the captured tree.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag for Phase 2 targeted DOM extraction to split the zone into its real default-content (video description) and block (related-posts card grid) rather than modeling it as one opaque block.
proposed_rules.rationale: The tree walker collapsed nested structure into one 3636px-tall node; treating it as a single block would lose the card-grid/related-posts semantics.
